sources.title: GitHub - adobe-research/speaker-identification
sources.snippet: Speaker Identification For speaker identification, we developed two main models: Individual Model: given an inidividual person name, the model tries to decide if the name belongs to any speaker around. Joint Model: given a sentence containing multiple names, the model tries to decide if each of the given names belongs to any speaker around.
